title: Confirm twins-1: 5.0 um of MZI A short arm on Si Slab (2/0, 90 nm partial etch); neither DRC nor LVS flags it
evidence: rv.cell_shapes('route_a_short'): Si = two pieces [47.4..58.774] and [63.774..192.6] at y 2.5..3.0; Si Slab piece [58.774..63.774]; Si inside the slab box = 0 um2 (only route piece in the chip on a non-Si layer). Slab extrusion 0..0.09 um, so the section is a 500 x 90 nm strip, n_eff 1.685 vs 2.440. rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.5,layer2='Si Slab') = 0.97 dB per joint; my local mode expansion over the 5 um section (work/rules/mini_eme.py, 35 propagating modes) gives 0.7 to 1.5 dB, plus about 0.15 dB Fresnel per joint (n_eff step 2.44 -> 1.69). Arm loss about 1 to 2 dB. DRC is silent (no pin there, widths > 60 nm); LVS is silent because the extraction connects Si Slab. Note also 2/0 is a 'Dedicated Run Layers' layer in this tech: on a standard EBeam run it may not be made at all, and then this is a 5 um gap (arm nearly dead).
impact: MZI A arms unbalanced by ~1-2 dB: extinction limited to ~20 dB, ~0.5-1 dB extra loss at the fringe peak, extra phase/group delay in the short arm, back-reflection.
fix: Draw the 5 um section on Si (1/0) at 0.5 um, remove the Si Slab polygon.

title: Confirm microscope-1 / twins-2: 0.5 um gap in MZI B short arm; LVS flags it (N8 split), DRC does not
evidence: rv.lvs(): intended net N8 [ebeam_y_1550#12.opt2, ebeam_y_1550#13.opt3] is in design_only; extraction gives two 1-pin nets (#12.opt2 at (47.4,256.75), #13.opt3 at (192.6,256.75)), so 'dangling' stays empty. Si pieces [47.4..137.149] and [137.649..192.6], y 256.5..257.0 (my rulecheck: the only pair of route pieces closer than 2 um, 0.500 um apart). DRC: gap 0.5 um > 60 nm min space, no marker. Transmission across 0.5 um of oxide: propagating-oxide-mode expansion keeps 39% of the input field (raw 4.9 dB), a Gaussian-beam estimate gives about 10 dB; plus two ~0.3 dB facet reflections.
impact: Short arm of MZI B passes only ~5-10 dB attenuated light: fringe contrast ~6-11 dB instead of >25 dB, ~2-4 dB extra loss at the peak, a Fabry-Perot reflector in the arm.
fix: Close the gap: one continuous 0.5 um Si straight from 47.4 to 192.6 at y=256.75.

title: Confirm intent-1: MZI A dL = 80.0 um; cause = both vertical legs of route_a_long 10 um short
evidence: Centre-line by area/0.5 um (work/rules/lengths.py): route_a_long = 225.201 um (straights 10 + 34.264 + 105.2 + 34.264 + 10, four R=5 bends 7.868 each), route_a_short = 145.2 um (Si + Si Slab) -> dL = 80.00 um (intent 100.0 +-0.5). Same bends and stubs in MZI B give 60.40 um, in tolerance. The vertical legs at x=62.4 and x=177.6 (y -42.014..-7.75) are 34.264 um; 100 um needs 44.264 um each (MZI B legs are 24.463 um, 20 um shorter for 40 um less dL, consistent).
impact: FSR = lambda^2/(n_g dL) = 1.55^2/(4.18*80) = 7.2 nm instead of 5.75 nm (+25%); MZI A does not meet its specification.
fix: Lengthen both vertical legs of route_a_long by 10.0 um (drop the bottom straight to y = -57.014).

title: Confirm intent-2 / twins-3: route_c_in 0.15 um off axis; it causes 3 of the 8 PDK DRC markers
evidence: rv.drc() (PDK deck SiEPIC_EBeam_DRC): SiEPIC-1a markers at [-0.05,507.75,0.05,508.25] (GC4 pin) and [115.15,507.75,115.25,508.25] (crossing pin), Si_space marker [-0.069,508.25,0.0,508.322] = the 0.15 um step notch where the shifted route meets the GC taper. rv.cross_section(0.3,508,0) and (114.9,508,0): core -0.10..+0.40 (centre +0.15), width 0.50. rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.5,offset=0.15) = 1.70 dB per joint (0.1 um gives 0.76, 0.005 um gives 0.002: quadratic), two joints = 3.4 dB on GC4 -> GC5.
impact: Loopback path loses ~3.4 dB: the loopback no longer measures the GC pair, so every MZI calibration against it is wrong by ~3.4 dB.
fix: Move route_c_in to y = 508.0 (centre on the GC4 and crossing pins).

title: Confirm twins-4: route_a_in is 0.30 um wide over 0 <= x <= 32.6; DRC flags both ends (SiEPIC-1a)
evidence: rv.drc(): SiEPIC-1a at [-0.05,-0.25,0.05,0.25] (GC0 pin) and [32.55,-0.25,32.65,0.25] (Y-branch #6 pin): PinRec encloses a 0.3 um core inside a 0.5 um pin. rv.cross_section(0.3,0,0) and (32.3,0,0): width 0.30, centred. rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.3) = 0.052 dB per joint (2 joints 0.105 dB); n_eff 2.440 -> 1.827 also gives ~2% Fresnel reflection per abrupt joint (~0.09 dB each), so the two joints make a 32.6 um Fabry-Perot (ripple period ~9 nm, up to ~0.3 dB p-p). Total ~0.1-0.3 dB.
impact: 0.1-0.3 dB extra loss and a small spectral ripple on the MZI A input; above the 0.05 dB unplanned-loss limit.

title: Confirm twins-5: 2.0 um long 0.25 um neck in route_a_out (x=265, y=19.024..21.024); DRC silent
evidence: My width check (work/rules/rulecheck.py: opening with r=0.248 um over every route piece) finds exactly two narrow parts in the chip: route_a_in (0.30 um) and [264.875,19.024,265.125,21.024] (0.25 um). DRC silent (0.25 > 60 nm min width, no pin). rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.25) = 0.86 dB per joint (no-recoupling bound 1.71 dB); local mode expansion over the 2 um neck (work/rules/mini_eme.py 0.25 Si 2.0) gives 2.1 dB (normalised) / 2.6 dB (raw); n_eff 2.44 -> 1.60 adds ~4% reflection per joint.
impact: About 1.7-2.6 dB loss on the MZI A output path (Y-branch #7 -> GC1): critical per the loss budget.
fix: Redraw the neck at 0.5 um (one continuous 0.5 um vertical leg from y=5 to y=122).

title: Confirm twins-6 / intent-5: two R=2.0 um bends in route_b_out; my mode solve 0.079 dB per bend vs 0.013 dB at R=5
evidence: Bend cells: bend__DEGE (route_b_out, at [260,253.75,262.25,256] and [260,381,262.25,383.25]) centre-line 3.147 um = pi/2 x 2.0; all other bends are bend__MRCU / bend__V4RY, 7.868 um = pi/2 x 5.0; the s-bend in route_c_out is two R=5 arcs. Local Tidy3D bend mode (10 nm grid, PML): R=2 guided TE n_eff 2.449, radiation 0.0003 dB/90deg, straight-bend overlap 0.039 dB per joint -> 0.079 dB per bend; R=5: 0.013 dB per bend (work/rules/bends.json). Extra vs R=5: 0.13 dB on GC2 -> GC3.
impact: ~0.13 dB extra loss on MZI B output, and the 2 um bends are more sensitive to width/sidewall variation.
fix: Use R=5 um bends (route_b_out vertical leg at x >= 265, like route_a_out).

title: Confirm twins-7 / intent-3: GC3 at y=383.0 (pitch 129/125); DRC and LVS silent
evidence: rv.find('ebeam_gc_te1550'): all six at x=0.0, angle 0, not mirrored; y = 0, 127, 254, 383, 508, 635.1 -> errors vs k*127: 0, 0, 0, +2.0, 0, +0.1. FbrTgt moved with it (378.5..387.5). Route_b_out ends at y=383 (straight [0,382.75,260,383.25]). With the array aligned to the other five GCs, a 2.0 um offset of a 10.4 um MFD fibre mode costs 4.34*(2/5.2)^2 = 0.64 dB (Gaussian overlap); splitting the error over the array lowers it but costs the other channels.
impact: ~0.3-0.6 dB on the MZI B output (GC3), and the fibre array cannot be centred on all six GCs at once.
fix: Place GC3 at y=381.0 and end route_b_out there (this also lets route_b_out use R=5 bends).

title: Confirm twins-8 / intent-4: GC5 +0.1 um and the R=5 s-bend in route_c_out are harmless (< 0.05 dB)
evidence: s_bend cell [198.589..200.0, 634.75..635.35]: 1.411 um long, 0.1 um offset, centre-line 1.415 um -> two arcs of R=(L^2+d^2)/(4d)=5.0 um (meets the 5 um rule), width 0.5. Local mode overlaps at R=5: straight-bend 0.006 dB per joint, curvature reversal 0.024 dB -> ~0.036 dB for the s-bend; fibre offset 0.1 um -> 0.0016 dB. Total ~0.04 dB, under the 0.05 dB limit.
impact: None measurable; a 0.1 um pitch error is well inside fibre-array placement tolerance.
fix: Optional: put GC5 at y=635.0 and drop the s-bend.

title: Confirm twins-9 optically harmless (0.004 dB), but rate low: route_b_in 5 nm offset is the cause of 3 PDK DRC markers
evidence: rv.drc(): SiEPIC-1a at [-0.05,253.75,0.05,254.25] (GC2 pin) and [32.55,253.75,32.65,254.25] (Y-branch #12 pin) and Si_space [-0.067,254.25,0.0,254.271] (5 nm step notch at the GC taper). rv.cross_section(0.3,254,0): core -0.245..+0.255. rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.5,offset=0.005) = 0.0019 dB per joint.
impact: No optical effect, but the deck is not clean: the submission needs a fix or a waiver (intent rule 'on axis' broken by 5 nm).

title: Confirm twins-10: crossing at 90 deg is harmless; the 4 LVS mismatches are pin names only (cell is 4-fold symmetric)
evidence: ebeam_crossing4#18 at (120,508) angle 90. Cell pins: opt (-4.8,0), opt2 (0,4.8), opt3 (0,-4.8), opt4 (4.8,0): through pairs opt-opt4 and opt2-opt3. Layout: GC4-opt2 and GC5-opt3 (a through pair, straight along y=508), terminators on opt/opt4 (the other through pair). Si of the cell rotated 90 deg about its centre: XOR 0.0049 um2 of 16.46 um2 (polygon rounding). The cell itself is identical to the siepic_forge library cell (XOR 0 on every layer).
impact: None for the light; the LVS report needs the intended netlist updated (or the cell rotated back) to be clean.
fix: Either rotate the crossing to 0 deg or update intent_nets.json pin names.

evidence: route_b_long by area/0.5 = 205.599 um, route_b_short drawn Si = 144.7 um + 0.5 um gap = 145.2 um -> 60.40 um (pi/2*R bends give 60.34).
